title: Demo: Behaviour observation check
description: A non-diagnostic check for deciding whether to keep observing, seek routine support, or get immediate external help when safety is at risk.

questions.prompt: Is a person or animal in immediate danger right now?
Is the observed behaviour repeatedly disrupting normal routines?

results.title: Continue calm observation
results.text: Keep brief notes about context and routine. This demo result does not identify a cause or condition.

results.title: Consider professional support
results.text: Consider discussing the repeated pattern with a qualified animal-care professional. This check is not a diagnosis.

results.title: Prioritise immediate safety
results.text: Move people and animals to safety when possible and contact an appropriate local emergency or animal-care service. This result does not identify a cause.

title: Demo: Grooming routine check
description: A draft planning check for a calm, gradual dog or cat grooming routine.

questions.prompt: How comfortable is the pet with brief handling?
How familiar is the household with the planned grooming task?
Are suitable basic supplies ready before starting?

results.title: Start with a short routine
results.text: Keep the first session brief and calm, then note what worked for the next routine.

results.title: Prepare in smaller steps
results.text: Gather supplies and introduce one small part of the routine at a time.

results.title: Consider qualified grooming support
results.text: Consider asking a qualified groomer or animal-care professional for practical, non-diagnostic support.

title: Demo: Pet home readiness
description: A simple onboarding checklist for preparing household basics before a pet arrives.

questions.prompt: Is a quiet, pet-appropriate space prepared?
Has the household agreed on a simple first-week routine?

results.title: Build the basics first
results.text: Choose one preparation step at a time before the planned arrival.

results.title: Finish the remaining plan
results.text: Most basics are underway. Complete the remaining items and keep the first routine simple.

results.title: Ready for a simple start
results.text: The basic plan is in place. Keep expectations flexible as the pet settles in.
